name: Hodge Park Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Blue, White. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: 6 holes with a wrong tee or pick (1, 3, 10, 11, 16, 17)

1: Blue OK (414 vs 425, normal back-of-box gap). White tee is on the 340 box; OSM has a box at 373 on the line, which matches the White card (380).
3: Par 3. OSM tags put Blue on the 156 box and White on the 124 box, but the hole has boxes at 113/124/135/144/156/167. Card 168/148 fits the 167 box (Blue) and 144 box (White): the colour tags are one box short.
6: Blue card 304 but the longest mapped box is 278 (boxes 253/272/278). Either a Blue box behind is unmapped in OSM or the card is long. White (272 vs 269) OK.
8: Dogleg; boxes at 267/359/393 vs card 409/388/369. The tagged Blue box (393) is closer to the White card number, so the real Blue box may be unmapped (16 yds back). White on the 359 box is 29 short of card 388.
10: wrong hole line (router) + wrong tee position
rv14 (2026-11-02): the published page (build 12:02) was right: OSM way/1565676856 tee -> NE over the cart path -> fairway bend -> N to the green, 373 yds, Blue 400 / White 366 measured.
11: Par 5, 455 vs 459 Blue; White 431 vs 445 (-14) acceptable. rv14 Red: the OSM red-tagged box is a forward tee; it measured 389 vs card 429.
12: Par 3. Boxes 110/147/164 vs card 193/172/149: tagged Blue (164) fits White card, White (147) fits Red.
13: Boxes 347/369 only, card 388/376/356. Blue box likely unmapped ~19 yds back; tagged White box 347 is 29 short of card 376.
16: Par 3 177 vs 192 (-15) Blue, White 161 vs 168. Green box on green. rv14 Red: the OSM red-tagged box is a forward tee; it measured 144 vs card 161.
17: Blue 516 vs 518 OK. White is tagged on a box 598 yds out (behind Blue, near the 7th green/6th green complex) vs card 485. OSM has a box at 489 on the line in front of Blue: move White there (27 yds in front of Blue).
